title: security(rbac): enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging for Private & Dedicated
author: Maya Patel
description: Context and motivation: Customers running Redwood Private and Dedicated deployments require guaranteed KMS residency and audit logging enforcement to meet regulatory requirements. This PR implements RBAC v2-level enforcement for KMS region pinning and ensures audit logging is enabled/validated during policy evaluation and at deploy-time. The change touches the RBAC policy model, admission checks, installer templates, and adds integration tests and migration scripts. Summary of changes: 1) RBAC v2 policy schema extended with explicit kms_residency and audit_logging fields and validation rules; 2) Admission controller enhancements to reject or audit non-compliant resource creations (modes: audit/enforce); 3) KMS integration layer updated to surface region metadata and enforce region pinning when policy mode == enforce; 4) Installer & Helm charts: new flags for default residency and audit logging; 5) Migration utility: automatic audit-mode migration path for existing policies; 6) Integration and unit tests covering enforcement, audit-mode, and rollback scenarios; 7) Docs and release notes updates. Checklist: - [x] Schema change + validation - [x] Admission controller enforcement + audit path - [x] KMS metadata plumbing (region, key tags) - [x] Installer/helm flags + defaults - [x] Migration script and dry-run mode - [x] Integration tests (end-to-end) - [x] Docs + changelog entry - [x] Security review done Notes: Default rollout will set new policies to audit mode to avoid customer incident. Enforcement must be enabled explicitly by admin or via upgrade script with opt-in. Migration script prints a dry-run report and requires operator confirmation to flip mode to enforce. Backwards compatibility: older policies without kms_residency field are treated as audit-mode by default.
